title: How Private Mortgage Insurance Ends on Rural Home Loans: Cancellation on Request and Automatic Termination
content:
Private mortgage insurance on a Rural Home Loans loan ends in one of two ways.

## Cancellation on the member's request

On the member's written request, registered as a mortgage insurance cancellation request, it is cancelled once principal is at or below the product's request cancellation level of the original value (the current loan-to-value, so curtailments count), provided no payment has been 30 or more days late in the product's 30-day look-back months before the request, none 60 or more days late in the product's 60-day look-back months before it, no payment is past due, and a broker price opinion ordered at the member's cost of the product's valuation fee shows the home's value is not below the original value. Mortgage insurance may be cancelled on request only when the member has a mortgage insurance cancellation request on file for the loan.

## Automatic termination

Independently, it terminates automatically on the first payment due date on which principal is scheduled under the original amortization to reach the product's automatic termination level of the original value, provided the loan is current, with no request and no valuation fee.

## In either case

The premium stops with the next payment due date and the escrow deposit is reduced by it at once; premiums already paid are not refunded. Value is always measured against the original value, never against a new appraisal of a higher value.

## Measures

- **Current loan-to-value:** the principal balance divided by the original value, as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals; the request test is met when it is at or below the request cancellation level.
- **Days late:** for each monthly bill in the look-back, the calendar days from its due date to the effective date of the payment that completed it, or to the day considered if it is still open.
- **Past due:** a monthly bill whose due date is earlier than the day considered and which is not paid in full, forborne months excluded.

## Request on file

Cancellation on request rests on the system record: a mortgage insurance cancellation request on file for the same loan, read before the cancellation. A member's statement that a request was sent is not that record.

## The two routes side by side

| | On request | Automatic |
|---|---|---|
| Principal measured | actual principal balance (curtailments count) | principal scheduled under the original amortization |
| Level | request cancellation level | automatic termination level |
| Payment history | no 30-day late in the 30-day look-back, no 60-day late in the 60-day look-back, none past due | loan current |
| Request on file | required | none |
| Broker price opinion | required, at the member's cost of the valuation fee | none |

*Hypothetical figures:* on an original value of 250000.00 USD, a principal balance of 199900.00 is a current loan-to-value of 79.96, at or below a request level of 80; a balance of 200100.00 is 80.04, above it.
